fields.name: name
fields.coerce: none: copied to `player.tskin` with no check
fields.description: The temporary skin, usually a key of `G.skins` or a monster type. The server does not validate it: a value that is not a skin name goes to every client in your `skin` field. `undefined` (no `name`) clears the temporary skin.

responses.name: Success
responses.summary: Your state (`resend "u+cid"`): `skin` is the new temporary skin (`tskin || skin`).

rows.when: No character: the handler reads `player.role` before it checks `player`, and throws.

confirm.note: The wrapper adds 16 to the call cost and emits `game_error` `"ERROR!"` unless that pushes the cost over the limit (then `limitdcreport` and a disconnect)
